description: This source file implements a linked list data structure with functions for initialization, insertion, appending, removal, destruction, and counting elements. It is part of the cURL project and manages linked list operations within that codebase.

methods.name: void Curl_llist_init(struct Curl_llist * l,Curl_llist_dtor dtor)
methods.description: Initializes a linked list structure with a destructor callback.

methods.name: void Curl_llist_insert_next(struct Curl_llist * list,struct Curl_llist_element * e,const void * p,struct Curl_llist_element * ne)
methods.description: Inserts a new element after the specified element in the list.

methods.name: void Curl_llist_append(struct Curl_llist * list,const void * p,struct Curl_llist_element * ne)
methods.description: Appends a new element to the end of the list.

methods.name: void Curl_llist_remove(struct Curl_llist * list,struct Curl_llist_element * e,void * user)
methods.description: Removes the specified element from the list, invoking destructor if provided.

methods.name: void Curl_llist_destroy(struct Curl_llist * list,void * user)
methods.description: Destroys the entire list, removing and freeing all elements.

methods.name: size_t Curl_llist_count(struct Curl_llist * list)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.
